```python
from itertools import permutations

riders = ("Reynaldo", "Seamus", "Theresa", "Yuki")
bikes = ("F", "G", "H", "J")
valid = []

for p1 in permutations(bikes):
    day1 = dict(zip(riders, p1))
    if day1["Theresa"] != "J":
        continue
    for p2 in permutations(bikes):
        day2 = dict(zip(riders, p2))
        if any(day1[r] == day2[r] for r in riders):
            continue
        if "F" in (day1["Reynaldo"], day2["Reynaldo"]):
            continue
        if "J" in (day1["Yuki"], day2["Yuki"]):
            continue
        if "H" not in (day1["Theresa"], day2["Theresa"]):
            continue
        if day1["Yuki"] != day2["Seamus"]:
            continue
        valid.append((day1, day2))

options = {
    "A": lambda d1, d2: d2["Reynaldo"] == "G",
    "B": lambda d1, d2: d1["Seamus"] == "H",
    "C": lambda d1, d2: d2["Yuki"] == "H",
    "D": lambda d1, d2: "J" in (d1["Seamus"], d2["Seamus"]),
    "E": lambda d1, d2: "G" in (d1["Theresa"], d2["Theresa"]),
}

print("Exhaustive valid schedules:", len(valid))
possible = []
for label, predicate in options.items():
    witnesses = [(d1, d2) for d1, d2 in valid if predicate(d1, d2)]
    print(label, "satisfying schedules:", len(witnesses))
    if witnesses:
        possible.append(label)
        d1, d2 = witnesses[0]
        print("  Witness day 1:", d1)
        print("  Witness day 2:", d2)

print("Options that could be true:", possible)
submitted = "A"
print("CHECK PASS" if possible == [submitted] else "CHECK FAIL")
```
